text: Samart Corporation PCL (listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand) is controlled by the Vilailuck family: its top-ten major shareholders report of 30 December 2025 shows the Vilailuck Group holding 42.176%, with the other top-ten entries individuals and Thai private companies.
short: Samart Corp is SET-listed; the Vilailuck family group holds 42.176%.

source.name: Samart Corporation PCL: Major Shareholders (investor page)
source.note: The page ('Major shareholders' report on December 30, 2025 prepared by Thailand Securities Depository') lists the Vilailuck group and nine other non-state holders.
